select 'twin_epoch' k, twin_tag || ' started ' || started_at::text || coalesce(' ENDED ' || ended_at::text, ' open') v from live_paper_twins where live_tag = 'Hmmsell10'
union all select 'H_order', market_ticker || ' qty=' || quantity || ' px=' || limit_price || ' ' || coalesce(status,'') from live_orders where strategy = 'Hmmsell10'
union all select 'F_new_orders', count(*)::text from live_orders where strategy = 'Fmmsell10' and created_at > '2026-10-04T02:18:55Z'
union all select 'H_twin_paper', count(*)::text from paper_trades where strategy = 'Hmmsell10_pt4'
